description: Rank of the security within its country, on a 1-100 scale.
Rank of the security within its region and industry group, on a 1-100 scale.
Rank of the security within its region, on a 1-100 scale.
Rank of the security within its region and economic sector, on a 1-100 scale.
Combined Alpha Model Region Rank; A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same region, representing the StarMine Combined Alpha Model score for a security listing. Higher ranks are more bullish.

Combined Alpha Model Country Rank. A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same country, representing the StarMine Combined Alpha Model score for a security listing. Higher ranks are more bullish.

Combined Alpha Model Sector Rank. A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same region and TRBC economic sector. There are ten TRBC economic sectors. Higher ranks are more bullish within a given sector.

Combined Alpha Model Industry Rank. A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same region and TRBC industry group. There are approximately 53 TRBC industry groups. Higher ranks are more bullish within a given industry group.
